def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for y in range(3 * h):
        by, iy = divmod(y, h)
        sy = h - 1 - iy if by in (0, 2) else iy
        row = []
        for x in range(2 * w):
            bx, ix = divmod(x, w)
            sx = w - 1 - ix if bx == 0 else ix
            row.append(grid[sy][sx])
        out.append(row)
    return out
